facts.fact: The World Bank project paper states 448,243 refugees and asylum-seekers were registered in South Sudan as of March 2024, in over 21 locations.

The World Bank project paper says targeting and registration of beneficiaries of the SNSOP cash transfers, which expects 7,000 refugee households, has started using an MIS linked to a biometric registration tool and payment application.
facts.system: SNSOP management information system with biometric registration tool
